## Dashboard

I create a [flexdashboard](dashboard.html) using the `Instacart` dataset and it includes three distinct plot types.

I conducted data cleaning and filtering on the dataset, and studied the following three issues:

* The products that are most frequently added to the cart.
* The distribution of the sequence in which different departments' products are added to the cart.
* The trend of order quantities at different times of the day.
